title: Puthoff-Green-Davis email chain on alien autopsy

tellings.quote: an email chain with how put off Kit Green and Eric Davis talking about the Santilly alien autopsy film and so forth. And Kit Green saying he saw different pictures of an alien autopsy.

plain: In 2001 and 2002, the physicist Hal Puthoff, the physician Kit Green and the physicist Eric Davis traded emails about the Santilli alien autopsy film, a widely circulated film said to show doctors cutting open an alien body. In that exchange, according to an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb and who describes the email chain without saying where it came from, Green said he had seen different pictures of an alien autopsy. If true, it would mean Green saw autopsy images apart from that film.
